title: Warm Irish Wrap
description: A hearty German-inspired wrap filled with warm, melted cheese and Irish flavors.
instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the sliced Irish Sausage for 5 minutes or until browned, breaking into small pieces.
Add the sliced onions to the pan and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Add the shredded cheese to the pan and stir until melted.
Warm the wrap in the microwave for 10 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by placing the sausage and onion mixture onto the center of the wrap.
Drizzle with mustard and sprinkle with chopped parsley.
Fold the wrap in half to enclose the filling.
